title: RCF Functional Build Spec
description: Functional Build Specification. One per build session. Carries the mandatory bsId parent reference plus buildOrder and executionStatus. Owns its acIds[] scope (Acceptance Criteria delivered by this FBS) and its dependsOnFbsIds[] graph edge (other FBSs this one depends on).

noCodeNodes.description: Declares this build spec produces no traceable code (docs-only or config-only). rcf build --mark complete records it via --no-code-nodes and the CodeNode gate skips the spec.

dependsOnServices.description: Third-party services this FBS's work depends on, and how each dependency is intended to be attested by tests. Written at Define stage from the pre-flight config record. Optional at schema; build-side coverage-strict is what enforces the attestation matrix.

uiBearing.description: True when this FBS renders UI for a person. Written by the classifier at Define, or by the operator via rcf update. When true, --mark complete refuses without designStageComplete: true.

designStageComplete.description: Set to true by the Design worker or by rcf design --mark-complete once journeys, navModel, and themeAndA11y are authored and the operator considers the design settled. Gates the --mark complete transition on uiBearing FBSes.

id.description: Canonical service id in camelCase, matching the pre-flight config record entry for this service.

displayName.description: Human-readable service name (for example, Resend email API).

purpose.description: What this FBS uses the service for.

acIds.description: Acceptance criteria within this FBS's scope that this service dependency governs. An FBS may span mixed services.

preFlightRef.description: Pointer into the pre-flight config record (for example pfc-2026-07-30-001#services.resend). Provenance for how the attestation mode was chosen.

verdict.description: Classifier verdict. ui: the FBS renders HTML for a person. notUi: no visible rendering. operatorOverride: the operator ruled against the classifier's opinion.

signals.description: Matched signals when reason is keyword-scan.

uiClassification.description: Provenance for the UI-bearing classifier verdict on this FBS.

source.description: Which text field the signal was matched in.

journeys.description: Walk-throughs describing how a person progresses through the UI. At least one entry when the block is present.

authoredBy.description: The worker or operator label that authored the block.

designStage.description: Design substage artefacts (journeys, navigation model, theme and accessibility). All sub-fields are required-when-present in practice; the schema keeps them optional so partial drafts still validate during authoring.

id.description: Lowercase slug identifying the journey within the FBS.

actor.description: The person the journey belongs to (for example, signed-in owner).

goal.description: One-line statement of what the actor is trying to achieve.

steps.description: Short strings walking through the journey. Two to eight entries.

shape.description: Overall navigation shape. shared-persistent: one nav on every authenticated route. shared-per-section: consistent nav per section. none-single-page: single-route app. operator-declared-other: anything else; requires notes.

signedInAsAffordance.description: Whether a visible signed-in-as affordance is required on authenticated routes.

notes.description: Free text; required in practice when shape is operator-declared-other.

themeMode.description: Theme posture for the FBS. Default across the estate is light-default-with-toggle.

themeTokensModule.description: Project-relative path to the design tokens module (for example src/ui/tokens.ts).

contrastTargets.description: Short statement of the contrast targets (for example, WCAG AA 4.5 text, 3.0 large text, 3.0 UI component).

contrastTestPath.description: Project-relative path to the contrast test.

contrastTestAuthoredBeforePalette.description: Operator attestation that the contrast test was authored before the palette. Corroborated by git history at Stage 2 when history is available; the boolean stands alone when history is inconclusive.
